# GitHub Copilot instructions - Magma

The instructions for every coding agent in this repository, Copilot included, are in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the root: read it first and follow it. It is the only source,
and this file only points to it, so that the two cannot drift apart.

`AGENTS.md` lists the mistakes agents make here, and links what to read for each task: the
lint rules ([`docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md`](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)), the commit convention
([`docs/COMMITS.md`](../docs/COMMITS.md)), the git workflow
([`docs/WORKFLOW.md`](../docs/WORKFLOW.md)) and the rules for using the components
([`docs/agents/`](../docs/agents/)).
